market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL at ~$103 with recent peak ~$109. Hitting a $140 settlement by end of June requires a ~36% upward spike over 2 months — a level not seen even in the 2022 Russia/Ukraine shock. Would need major escalation (full sustained Hormuz closure plus military strikes). Roughly 7-13%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tail risk of severe military escalation or extended full closure of Hormuz.
